title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
summary: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.
llm_summary: Jensen Huang, Nvidia’s co‑founder and long‑time CEO, has stepped down after an alleged affair that has sparked a high‑profile scandal. The abrupt leadership change raises concerns for the tech industry, as Nvidia’s AI chips are central to both U.S. and Chinese efforts to build the world’s most advanced artificial‑intelligence infrastructure.
